title: Demis Hassabis says companies looking to replace developers with AI may be due to a "lack of imagination and a lack of understanding" of the future (Will Knight/Wired)
summary: Will Knight / Wired: Demis Hassabis says companies looking to replace developers with AI may be due to a “lack of imagination and a lack of understanding” of the future — The CEO of Google DeepMind tells WIRED that companies should use the productivity gains of AI to do more, not lay people off.
